content: Communication Management shall provide a method to send notifications on data change to other applications Status: DRAFT Description: Application developers shall be able to send notifications on change of a field value to other applications. Rationale: To share properties held in a central location with multiple consumers the providing application shall be able to notify all consumers of changes to the value. Dependencies: – Use Case: A provider of sensor data notifies the consumers that the current update rate has changed. Supporting Material: –
